0022600115.text: The Timberwolves (1-0, 3rd in the Northwest and 0.5 games back, 7th in the West) host the Toronto Raptors (1-0, 2nd in the Atlantic and 0.5 games back, 4th in the East), with both teams unbeaten so far this season. Minnesota is without Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery), and Toronto is missing Brandon Ingram (heel, surgery) and Nate Bittle (foot, fracture). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Timberwolves won both meetings in 2025-26, including a 115-107 win in Minneapolis on March 5, 2026.
